verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair privacy question for a SaaS productivity suite, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents a user or admin control to opt out of telemetry or usage tracking. The Reports API covers admins viewing usage reports, not opting out, and the Meet 'Take notes for me' settings are an unrelated feature control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
